goal: Predictively prefill missing transactions during compact block relay to avoid extra network round-trips
Speed up network-wide block propagation and reduce stale block risk without adding latency
reviewability: Review #35724 first; this PR is stacked on it and includes its changes
agreement: Broad concept support praising the backwards compatibility and simplicity (josibake, 0xB10C, murchandamus)
Verified with node telemetry confirming prefill effectiveness (m4ycon)
Tested across unit and compact block functional test suites (s00ly)
Objections regarding use-after-free, TCP syscalls, and logging counters addressed (andrewtoth, 0xB10C)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because avoiding an extra round-trip for 43% of block reconstructions speeds block propagation
Faster relay directly lowers the risk of stale blocks across the network
